name: io.github.veriko-mx-labs/veriko
title: Veriko
description: Verify Mexican SPEI transfers against the Banxico CEP and operate the Veriko public API.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Integrator API key (veriko_ followed by 64 hexadecimal characters). Optional for the tools that read public data.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: core, all or families separated by commas.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_MCP_MAX_RISK
environmentVariables.description: Highest risk advertised: read, write or destructive.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. HTTPS only, except localhost.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout per request in milliseconds, from 1000 to 300000.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Automatic retries of transient failures, from 0 to 5.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of the API error text: en or es.

environmentVariables.name: VERIKO_MCP_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directories, separated by the platform path delimiter, that image_path and file_path may read from. Without it those arguments are not advertised.
